description: Adsorption Energy of Atomic O at Rh(111) FCC Hollow Site (FCC Fm-3m, ISPIN=2 negative control, PBE)
user_prompt: Calculate the adsorption energy of atomic oxygen O on the Rh(111) surface (Fm-3m). Report the final adsorption energy Eads (in eV), defined as Eads = E(slab+O) - E(slab) - E(O).

method.modeling: Rh(111) slab with at least 4 layers, vacuum >= 15 Angstrom, and a 2x2x1 or larger surface supercell; adsorb atomic O at the fcc hollow site. Reference Eads to the clean Rh(111) slab plus a gas-phase triplet O atom.

key_parameters.magnetism: ISPIN=1 for Rh slab and slab+O; ISPIN=2, MAGMOM=2, NUPDOWN=2 for O gas

method.rationale: Value is the 0.25 ML fcc-hollow O/Rh(111) atomic-O binding energy from Ganduglia-Pirovano and Scheffler, written as negative Eads for this benchmark. This replaces the older indirect 1/2 O2-based conversion and avoids carrying forward the unsupported Loffreda citation. The +/-0.30 eV absolute tolerance covers coverage, PAW/all-electron and GGA/PBE differences, and the triplet atomic-O reference sensitivity.
